method: Newey-West HAC on weighted contrast series

details.weights: g_t = +1/n_h if state_t==high else (-1/n_l if state_t==low else 0), diff = sum g_t * spread_net_1x_t

results.ci_95_coverage_note: asymptotic normal approx (large T); with 30-day overlapping horizons and moderate T, inference is fragile

conclusion: Canonical high-low difference is positive (0.617) but not statistically significant at 95% under Newey-West HAC with lag 29 (t~1.55, CI includes 0). Overlap-aware uncertainty materially changes inference.
